message: `tests/link/package_target_mismatch_native/node_modules/pkg_twin/wasm.ts` is the wasm32 twin of `tests/link/package_target_mismatch_native/node_modules/pkg_twin/native.ts` and must export the same names with the same signatures, because a wasm32 build compiles it in its place: `scale` is `export const scale = (x: i32): i32 =>` in `tests/link/package_target_mismatch_native/node_modules/pkg_twin/native.ts` and `export const scale = (x: f64): i32 =>` in `tests/link/package_target_mismatch_native/node_modules/pkg_twin/wasm.ts`
